passage.text: During winter break, the Booha friends compare the ways people enjoy the holiday season. Nuppi hangs decorations, holiday lights, and a holiday tree for Christmas. Mimo builds a snowman and rides a sled before warming up with a hot drink. Booha practices ice skating, although he falls several times. On New Year's Eve, everyone joins a countdown. The next morning, they make their first shrine visit and later attend a family gathering. The activities are different, but each one brings people together during the cold winter.

comprehension.q: What does Mimo do before having a hot drink?
choices: He builds a snowman and rides a sled

comprehension.q: When does everyone join the countdown?
What do the activities have in common?

passage.text: Every family creates memories in a different way. Mister Happy's New Year tradition is a large family dinner with a special holiday meal. Nuppi follows a custom of making a card and cake for her grandparents. Mimo chooses music, hangs an ornament, and teaches everyone a traditional song. Booha takes a photo after they exchange a small gift. The celebration is simple, but the shared family time creates many smiles. Years later, the food and decorations may be forgotten, while the warm memory remains.

comprehension.q: What does the passage suggest people remember longest?

writingPrompt.en: Write 1–3 sentences about an important memory using tradition and family time.

passage.text: The friends plan a surprise for a child who will spend New Year in the hospital. Nuppi chooses a book and toy, while Booha writes a kind letter and thank-you card for the hospital staff. Mimo places each present in a box, adds gift wrapping, and ties it with a ribbon. Mister Happy prepares a gift bag and a New Year's money envelope. They do not expect to receive anything. Their purpose is to give thanks and show kindness. When the child opens the gifts, the biggest surprise is knowing that other people care.

passage.text: At the end of the year, Booha prepares a year in review. Each month taught him a different lesson. His greatest success was finishing a difficult activity, while his biggest challenge was continuing after a mistake. A friend and teacher helped him notice his improvement. He also discovered a favorite new skill: writing short English stories. Booha chooses a goal for next year that is clear enough to follow and difficult enough to matter. Reflection does not change the past, but it helps him decide what to do next.

comprehension.q: Who helped Booha notice his improvement?

choices: It helps him choose what comes next

writingPrompt.jp: improvement と goal for next year を つかって、せいちょうを 1〜3ぶんで かいてね。
writingPrompt.en: Write 1–3 reflective sentences using improvement and goal for next year.
